root_cause: Upstream bc91f3cdd57c '[RISCV] Add 32 bit GPR sub-register for Zfinx. (#108336)' (companion 8a7843ca0ff5 '[RISCV] Add 16 bit GPR sub-register for Zhinx. (#107446)') changed GPRF32 from '(add GPR)' to the new X*_W sub-registers, so GPRF32 no longer has GPR's register set. The fork's PulpV2/PulpV4 (RISCVRegisterInfo.td, codegen-core) contain exactly the same registers as GPR and relied on TableGen's 'clique' handling (llvm/utils/TableGen/Common/CodeGenRegisters.cpp computeSubClasses: 'Sweep up missed clique members. They will be immediately preceding RC.') to make GPR a subclass of PulpV2/PulpV4. TopoOrderRC sorts same-size classes by name, so the order is now GPR(7), GPRF32(8), PulpV2(9), PulpV4(10); the sweep from PulpV2 stops at GPRF32 and never reaches GPR. Result in generated RISCVGenRegisterInfo.inc: at 19 PulpV2/PulpV4 SubClassMask contains GPR (0x03fbbff8 incl. bit 3), at 20 it does not (0x7f6bf600, GPR is bit 7), while GPR's mask still contains PulpV2/PulpV4. So when ISel constrains the PseudoPV_ADD_SC*_VL def (PulpV4/PulpV2) against SW's GPR operand, getCommonSubClass now returns PulpV2 instead of GPR, and -print-after-isel shows %N:pulpv2 (even for the _B pseudos) instead of %N:gpr. The register set of the chosen class is identical (X0-X31), so allocation/semantics are unchanged; only the virtual-register class name in MIR differs. No TableGen semantic change in CodeGenRegisters.cpp/InfoByHwMode.cpp in the range (only NFC const/pair commits).
question: pulp-select-pseudo.ll expects ':gpr' but 20 yields ':pulpv2' because GPR is no longer a subclass of the fork's PulpV2/PulpV4 register classes (TableGen clique broken by upstream bc91f3cdd57c). Which resolution do you want? (A) Follow upstream: upstream (llvmorg-22.1.7 RISCVRegisterInfo.td:248-252, GPRRegisterClass types include 'P extension packed vector types: XLenVecI8VT, XLenVecI16VT, XLenVecI32VT') and the PULP 22 fork (pulp/llvmorg-22.1.7-pulp, same lines; no PulpV2/PulpV4 classes at all) put v4i8/v2i16 into GPR itself; doing that at 20 means adding v2i16/v4i8 to GPRRegisterClass, deleting the PulpV2/PulpV4 classes and replacing all PulpV2/PulpV4 operands in RISCVInstrInfoXpulp.td (insn-tablegen cluster) and addRegisterClass in RISCVISelLowering.cpp with GPR — this deletes fork code and spans two clusters, so it needs approval (AGENT_RULES 9, 'two plausible fixes'). (B) Rename PulpV2/PulpV4 so they sort between 'GPR' and 'GPRF32' and rejoin the clique (e.g. 'GPRPulpV2'): small, but a name-ordering hack with no upstream precedent. (C) Accept the behaviour as correct (identical register sets, same allocation) and have test-regen update the expectation to pulpv2 — changes a fork test oracle, so owner decision.
